five_day_thesis: IV has cratered from 20.47% to 15.69% (-4.78pp, -23% relative) over the last 5 sessions — the single biggest change in the window — while spot has round-tripped $4,016 → $4,151.8 → $4,050.3 → $4,070.9, netting only +$54.9 (+1.4%) despite the volatility. Max pain has been essentially pinned (4,800 → 4,795 → 4,795 → 4,795 → 4,800, zero net drift) and both the put wall ($4,000) and call wall ($5,370) have not moved a single strike in 5 days, meaning the wide structural range is stale while the tradeable action happens inside it. Dealer gamma posture has flip-flopped three times in five sessions (negative → negative → positive → negative → positive), which combined with the IV crush points to a market that sold volatility hard into a chopping, non-trending range rather than establishing a directional regime. P/C OI ratio drifted slightly lower (0.54 → 0.51) as call OI grew faster than put OI, a modest bullish skew building underneath the range.
